$$IJ = \frac{r_A-r}{s_A}=\frac{r\cdot a}{(s-a)\,s_A}=\frac{r}{s_B\,s_C}.$$

Hence $\displaystyle J=\frac{r}{s_B s_C}(\sin\tfrac C2,\cos\tfrac C2)=\Bigl(\frac{r}{s_B},\;\frac{r\,c_C}{s_B s_C}\Bigr).$

**Center $O_b$.** The circle $\omega_b$ is tangent to line $CI$ at $I$, so $O_b$ lies on the line through $I$ perpendicular to $CI$ (direction $\theta_C-\frac\pi2=\frac A2$).
